code.lesson_not_available: Lesson {{number}} "{{title}}" is still planned and can't be opened or run yet.
code.invalid_request: The request parameters are invalid. Check the lesson, mode, question, and exercise.
code.onboarding_unavailable: The intro content is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
code.glossary_unavailable: The glossary is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
code.offline_requires_preset: Offline mode runs only preset exercises. Switch to real-model mode for free-form input.
code.fault_injection_offline_only: This exercise injects faults offline. Switch to offline mode.
code.test_inputs_fixed: Test mode accepts only the structured inputs preset for this exercise.
code.inputs_invalid: The lesson inputs are invalid. Check the fields, types, and ranges this lesson requires.
code.runtime_unavailable: The lesson runtime is temporarily unavailable. Check the lesson configuration.
code.no_offline_fixture: This lesson has no deterministic test-model scenario.
code.live_not_configured: Real-model mode needs a configured model, service URL, and an API key for the selected provider. Local Ollama needs no key.
code.run_not_found: The run record doesn't exist or has been cleared.
code.run_busy: The previous run hasn't finished. Wait for the network request to return (network timeout: 60 seconds).
code.run_active: A run is still in progress. Clear records after it finishes.
code.run_not_active: This run has already finished. There is nothing to stop.
code.no_pending_approval: This run has no approval waiting to be handled.
code.approval_not_supported: Handling approvals isn't supported in this version yet.
code.invalid_locale: The language code format is invalid.
code.recording_stale: The lesson source has changed, so this recording is out of date. Record it again.
code.recording_invalid: The recording failed validation and was rejected.
code.code_unavailable: This lesson's source can't be parsed right now. Check the lesson source and the Code scene content.

client.noStream: The browser couldn't read the event stream.
client.streamEnded: The connection ended early and no completion event arrived. Check the backend status.
client.streamRetriesExhausted: The event stream was interrupted several times and no completion event arrived. The run record is still saved on the local server. Check the backend status.
client.inputsNotObject: Enter a JSON object, for example {} or {"limit": 3}.
client.inputsSyntax: The JSON is incomplete or invalid. Check the quotes, commas, and brackets, then run again.
client.stoppedNotice: Stopped receiving events and requested cancellation of the remaining steps. A model request that was already sent may still finish. You can run again shortly.
